_comment: Anthropic API key templates. Note: Anthropic doesn't support Organization ID via env var the way OpenAI does.

anthropic_env.name: anthropic_env
anthropic_env.description: Inject ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Anthropic SDK and CLI tools
anthropic_env.cli: agent-knots vault template add anthropic/api --name anthropic_env --env '{"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "$value"}'

curl_bearer.name: curl_bearer
curl_bearer.description: Wrap curl with x-api-key header for Anthropic REST API
